label: Bible Study
prompt: Let every thing that hath _____ praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verse: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
note: The last verse of the whole Psalter — everything with lungs is invited to the choir.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from _____: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
verse: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
note: To Rachel weeping for her children: refrain thine eyes from tears — they shall come again.

label: Sunday School
prompt: To him the _____ openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
verse: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
note: The porter was the sheepfold's gatekeeper; the sheep follow because they know the shepherd's voice.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with _____ heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verse: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
note: Peter's day-of-the-Lord forecast: the very elements melting — the ultimate controlled burn.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made _____ for the transgressors.
verse: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
note: Isaiah 53 ends in prayer: numbered with the transgressors, he 'made intercession' for them — as Jesus did on the cross (Luke 23:34).
